howto: Pick a difficulty and press New life.
Click an object in the 3D house (fridge, stove, shower, bed, TV, phone, computer...) and pick an action from the bubbles over it; click the floor to walk there.
Keep all six needs out of the red; work at the computer for money and order groceries on the phone.
Tick off the three goals each day; at midnight the day summary shows how you did.
tips: Snacks and meals use groceries from your inventory: order more on the phone before you run out.
Work pays $140 but drains energy, fun and hygiene, so shower and relax afterwards.
Every goal pays $25, and finishing all three wins a trophy.
Sleep is the only big energy refill: go to bed before energy turns red.
Turn Autonomy off to make every choice yourself, or leave it on to let your Sim look after itself.

controls.keyboard: Click objects, actions and the floor; keys 1-4 set the speed (1x, 5x, 15x, 60x); Space, P or Esc pauses
controls.touch: Tap objects, actions and the floor; speed buttons in the top bar, Goals opens today's goals, inventory and log; pause button top right

difficulty: Relaxed, Normal and Hard on the title card: needs drop 40% slower or faster than Normal, and groceries cost $15, $18 or $24.

cheats.effect: +$1000 (and every new life starts with it)

features.autosave: Saves after every activity and every game hour (and on Exit); Continue on the title card picks it up
features.goals-or-quests: Three daily goals in the Goals panel (right side, or the Goals button on a phone), $25 each, a trophy for all three
features.day-time-ui: Day and clock in the top bar, speed buttons 1x to 60x, day and night lighting in the house, and an end-of-day summary card at midnight
features.inventory: Inventory panel: groceries (used by snacks and meals, bought on the phone) and trophies
features.results: End-of-day summary card: goals done, money earned, groceries left, days lived and best

settings.quality: Graphics: High / Low button on the title card (Low renders at 1x with no shadows, no night lamps and fewer garden props; a CPU-rendered device starts on Low)
